unit: Source-deal average of four rotation refusal indicators, each in[0,1]. All54planned source deals retained; ineligible/settled/forced requests do not attempt kernel and have refusalindicator0. This is unconditional planned-root risk, distinct from refusal conditional on eligibility.
assumption: Independent PRNG source-deal draws, fixed nine-declaration stratification. Pointwise intervals, not simultaneous family coverage; horizons share deals. No PRNG independence proof or universal deadline guarantee.
